svg.title: How it sorts each new message: Addition (for example 'also add navy'): Merged into the job now; Correction (for example 'its 500 not 200'): Applied. Old value gone; Replacement (for example 'make it a post instead'): Only the new version; New task (for example 'btw what are the fees'): Kept separate, done after; Question (for example 'how long will this take'): Short answer, keeps going; Do this first (for example 'faq first, its urgent'): Reordered. Nothing dropped; Stop (for example 'nvm scrap that'): Stopped at once; Sent twice (for example 'check ebay · check ebay'): Answered once; Standing rule (for example 'never below £18'): Applies to everything.
